summary: This study aimed to develop and validate an interpretable machine learning model to detect vision-threatening diabetic retinopathy (VTDR) among patients with diabetic retinopathy (DR) using clinical data from 1,124 patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus. The best-performing model, a Support Vector Machine (SVM), achieved an Area Under the Curve (AUC) of 0.879 and accuracy of 0.837, outperforming other machine learning models. The model's performance was evaluated using a comprehensive scoring system and decision curve analysis, and a simplified calculator derived from Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) feature importance rankings maintained strong diagnostic capacity.
